02 Services

What we build

Full service landscape construction for residential homes across the GTA, from the front entrance to the back fence.

Stone Porches and Steps

Entrance ways rebuilt in natural stone, with solid steps that make the front of the house feel finished.

Interlocking Pavers

Driveways, patios and walkways using Unilock, Permacon, Banas, Techo Bloc, Best Way Stone and more.

Retaining Walls

Structural and garden walls that hold grade, manage slopes and give tiered yards a clean, usable shape.

Walkways and Patios

Flagstone set in mortar or on a sand base, laid out for how your family actually moves through the yard.

Gardens and Planting

Garden installation and planting that softens the stone work and gives the space colour through the seasons.

Landscape Lighting

Low voltage lighting that makes steps safe, stone glow after dark, and patios usable into the evening.

Carpentry and Fencing

Custom carpentry and fencing built to match the stone work, not fight with it.

Artificial Turf

Artificial turf and playground flooring for low maintenance play areas that stay green all year.

3D Design

Simple, clean 3D designs so you can see the project before we break ground, planned to meet your budget.

03 About

Meet John Edmunds

John founded Edmunds Landscaping in 2013, after nearly 20 years in the landscape construction industry. He knows the trade from the ground up because he spent two decades working in it before putting his own name on the truck.

As a husband and father of two young boys, John builds the kind of outdoor spaces he would want at his own home: functional first, beautiful second, and safe for kids to grow up in. That family lens shapes every porch, patio and play area the company builds across the GTA.

How payment works

You never pay the full price up front. Every build, the website, the Lead System and the e-commerce add-on, is paid in stages that match the work done, so you only pay for progress you can see.

Step 1 · 50%

50% to start

Half up front books the work and gets the build moving. Nothing else is due until you can see it taking shape.

Step 2 · 25%

25% as the work takes shape

The next quarter is due as the build progresses, in step with the work done. You see the site coming together before you pay it.

Step 3 · 25%

Final 25% when it goes live

The last quarter is due on completion, when the finished site is live and handed over to you. No final payment before the work is done.

Getting found: Google, and the AI answers

Homeowners do not all search the same way anymore. Some type into Google. More and more ask an AI assistant or read an AI written summary instead. The website is set up for all of it. Three services, in plain words:

Included

SEO: found on Google

Search Engine Optimization. Your pages carry the words homeowners actually search, your services and service area are spelled out clearly, and the site loads fast on phones. When someone nearby searches Google for a landscaper, your site is set up to show up in those results.

Included

AEO: quoted in AI answers

Answer Engine Optimization. When a homeowner asks ChatGPT, Google’s AI answers or a voice assistant who builds interlocking patios in Toronto, the answer is pulled from websites that state their facts clearly. Your services, your 2-year guarantee and your reviews are written and structured so those tools can quote Edmunds Landscaping as the answer.

Included

GEO: named in AI search

Generative Engine Optimization. As search results turn into AI generated summaries, GEO keeps your business named in them: the same accurate facts about Edmunds Landscaping, your services, your area and your guarantee, kept consistent across your site and your profiles, so AI describes you correctly instead of guessing.

What to expect

The $300 covers setup and build. We set up your domain and email, finish the site with your real photos, connect the quote form, and hand over the logins at launch. Here is what that looks like, step by step, and what stays in your name the whole time.

Your domain and email

edmundslandscaping.com already belongs to Edmunds Landscaping. Buying this site does not change that, and nothing below hands it over to us.

Handled for you

Domain transfer and setup

We set up your domain and point it at the new site: DNS pointed and settings configured so edmundslandscaping.com loads again with the new site. The domain stays registered in your name, at your registrar, under your control. You pay the registrar’s yearly renewal, and we handle the settings and reminders.

Your call

Do you want email on your domain?

If you want email on your own domain, we can set up mailboxes like john@edmundslandscaping.com through Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, whichever you prefer. The account is opened in your name, you pay the provider’s per-mailbox rate, and we handle the setup. If you would rather keep your current email, that works too.

Yours outright

The keys are handed over

At launch you get the logins: domain, hosting and site admin, all registered to Edmunds Landscaping. If you ever move on, the site files, the content and the domain go with you. Nothing is held hostage.

After launch: running the site yourself

You do not need technical skills to keep this site current. You run the business in plain words, and the site follows.

Plain words

Manage it in everyday language

With the website, you get an AI-assisted builder. You can update and manage your site just by writing in plain, everyday language — no technical skill needed, no code to learn. Want a photo swapped, a service added, or wording changed? Just describe the change in plain words and the builder makes it for you. Each client gets their own builder, and when your site is done, the access is handed over to you so it is yours to run. That builder costs about $35 CAD a month (US$25).*Limited usage applies If you would rather not run it yourself, Protiva can manage it for you instead — that is the monthly retainer.

Included

Minor tweaks are included

Small, straightforward changes are included: fixing a typo, updating a phone number, swapping a photo, adding new project photos, or tweaking wording. On the management retainer that covers up to 4 content updates a month.

Quoted first

Bigger work is quoted up front

Anything bigger or more complicated, like a new page, a new feature, online selling, or reworking a whole section, is not included as a minor tweak. We quote it up front as an additional charge, you approve it first, and only then does the work start. No surprise bills.

With the Lead System: the services behind the CRM and CMS

The $2,000 package is more than software. These are the services that come with it, in the order they happen.

First

The audit

Before anything is built, we audit how enquiries reach you today: the website, the phone, Instagram and the inbox, and map where leads get lost. The system is then built around your real workflow, not a generic one.

Then

Implementation

The CRM and CMS are configured to how you run jobs: lead stages from new request to quoted to booked, the details you need on every job, and automated follow-up sequences that nurture leads who have not booked yet, so no quote goes cold in the inbox.

Yours

The database, and your data

Every lead lives in a database that belongs to Edmunds Landscaping, backed up regularly. Your customer list is your asset: it can be exported to a spreadsheet at any time you ask, and it leaves with you if you ever leave.

Ongoing

Hosting

The site and the lead system are hosted together, with SSL and uptime monitoring, under the Hosting and Care service above. One home for everything, and because you own the files and the data, hosting can move whenever you say so.

Ongoing

Email notifications

Every quote request lands in your inbox, not a spam folder, and the homeowner gets an instant confirmation that their request arrived. The behind-the-scenes tools that send those emails are part of the running costs covered under Hosting and Care.

Handover

Training and handover

We walk you through the system on a call, hand over a short written quick-start guide and every login, and set it up so you can run it yourself from day one. No developer needed for the everyday stuff.

Audit first. We looked before we built. Owned by you. Site, content and tech. Live in days, not months.
